definitions.U: T54 test rows, condition current (AG3S.reset() per frame, no TargetConfirm history / latch / freeze / HSR gate), arm L8H2 (serving last:L8H2), C1a build kwargs
definitions.U_class: strict plurality of GT point labels (t47b_metrics B2 classes) of the chosen cluster, unlabelled ignored; grounding_status != ok or chosen_n == 0 -> no_target; tie -> tie (0 frames); support = table
definitions.S: T53 server chunk summary_json of the same frame: manipulated (id, state, centroid, n_points), exclusion.attached_label, grasp.state, admissibility.decision.latched, exclusion.grasp_active, subtask.p / subtask.label
definitions.S_class: GT object (apple, banana, orange, pear, crate; body origin in robot base frame, MuJoCo pose of recorded qpos) nearest to S manipulated.centroid at the same frame; target fruit -> target, crate -> destination, other fruit -> other_object, no manipulated -> no_target (task definition)
definitions.S_class_at_geometry_frame: added variant: same nearest-object rule, GT positions taken at manipulated.last_seen_frame (the frame the centroid geometry was observed). Reason: during attached / occluded frames manipulated.centroid is the geometry of last_seen_frame (frame table field S_geometry_frame)
definitions.phase: T53 gt/<key>.grasp.npz grasp_state (pre, held, post, placed, held_other_hand); held_other_hand 0 frames
definitions.window: frame 0 .. min(first placed frame, first frame with S subtask.label == home), both inclusive; no placed and no home -> episode end
definitions.alignment: T54 row t_step == 8*frame == gt t_step == grasp t_step == planning-row t_step; planning-row seq == server chunk t_step == summary t_step; chunk_index - first chunk_index of the episode segment == frame; manipulated.frame == frame; exec_feedback.t_step_start == 8*(frame-1) for frame >= 1. Server chunk t_step is the request sequence (= frame + 1), not frame*8
definitions.aggregation: episode mean = per-episode fraction within the phase, mean over episodes with >= 1 frame of that phase (equal weight); pooled = frame sum
definitions.ci: episode bootstrap, resample episodes with replacement, B 10000, seed 5407, percentile 2.5 / 97.5; same draw for all quantities of one episode set (16 / success 9 / failure 7)
definitions.gt_target_visible: GT target >= 200 px in >= 1 of 3 cameras (T54 has_target rule), supplementary only
definitions.representative_episode_rule: success episode with the largest number of held frames (in window) where U != target; tie -> smaller episode number (T59.task.md, fixed before results)
definitions.scene_frame_rule: pre = lower-median pre frame of the window; held = first and last held frame with U != target (verifier, fixed before rendering)
definitions.window_W1: W1 (place end): frame 0 .. min(first placed frame, first frame with S subtask.label == home), both inclusive; no placed and no home -> episode end. Identical to 'window' (the first T59 measurement).
definitions.window_W2: W2 (home-return end): episodes without placed -> W1 end. Episodes with placed -> first frame j >= first placed frame with used-arm ready distance <= 0.2 rad (inclusive); not reached -> episode end (count and minimum distance reported). Not cut by HSR label.
definitions.ready_distance: SUBTASK-e definition: q_ready = traj.npz measured_qpos[0] (16-D state at control step 0, after the 1000 warm-up steps), used arm columns (left 0..6, right 8..14), ||q - q_ready||_2 in rad. Frame q = recorded qpos of the frame (policy record step qpos, MuJoCo joints <arm>_arm_0..6) == traj inference_states[frame] (max abs diff 0.0) == measured_qpos[8*frame - 1] for frame >= 1. used arm = gt/<key>.grasp.npz used_arm. Supplementary: same rule on the 600 control-step measured_qpos trace.
definitions.S_no_target_W2: S and Sg class = no_target when the serving chunk has no manipulated object (unchanged rule). S_no_target_kind: 'released' if subtask.released was True at any frame <= this frame of the episode (B3 release seen), else 'not_released'.
definitions.placed_S_state: S state of the same frame: manipulated present (manipulated.centroid not None), exclusion.active, subtask.label (HSR confirmed).
definitions.representative_frame_table: ep1839 rows per frame: phase = grasp_state; latch = S grasp.state (+att if exclusion.attached_label) as in the timeline latch row; S_decision_latched = admissibility.decision.latched; hsr_label = subtask.label; U = U_class; Sg = S_class_at_geometry_frame; S = S_class. segments = {value: [[start, end], ...]} of consecutive frames, inclusive.

numbers._layout: W1 = numbers of the first T59 measurement, unchanged (moved here as-is); W2 = home-return window; representative_frame_table_ep1839 = per-frame values and run segments for W1 and W2

placed_phase_table.frame_order_note: placed frames = first placed frame .. W2 end of the 9 success episodes

columns.latch: S_grasp_state (+att = S_attached), as in the timeline latch row
S_grasp_state (+att = S_attached), as in the timeline latch row

representative_returned.rule: representative = successful episode that returned within 0.2 rad of the ready pose, max number of held frames with U != target, tie -> smaller episode number (user decision 2026-10-13; ep1839, ep1866 excluded: not returned)
representative_returned.rule_ko: 대표 episode = 성공 · 준비 자세 0.2 rad 안 복귀 (W2_reached_ready) episode 중 held 에서 U != target frame 수 최대, 동률이면 episode 번호 작은 것 (사용자 판정 2026-10-13; ep1839 · ep1866 은 미복귀라 제외)

scene_frame_rule.i: first held frame with U_class != target
scene_frame_rule.ii: among placed frames with serving released (S_manipulated_present False, S_attached False, S_hsr_label home): first frame where U chose a cluster (U_chosen_n > 0, U_class != no_target); fallback = first released frame (fallback not used)
scene_frame_rule.iii: W2 end frame (first frame within 0.2 rad of the ready pose after first placed)

definitions.map_2d: T53 attention npz cell denoise 0 / agg last / layer 8 / head 2 (serving last:L8H2); class mass = t47_head_metrics.map_scores with GT class_cov, pooled over 3 cams weighted by raw map sum
definitions.seed_3d: T54 row seed__<class> / seed_n (top-5% percentile points minus support, B2 labels)
definitions.stage: for U_class != target, first that applies: S0 n_target_obs == 0; S1 seed__target == 0; S2g no cluster holds target points; S2m target points only in non-target-plurality clusters; S3 target-plurality cluster(s) all inadmissible; S4 admissible target-plurality cluster exists and another cluster is named
definitions.leader: rank-0 cluster by target_score in the T54 row cluster list (before admissibility)
definitions.windows: pre / held: W1; placed released: W2, phase placed and S_no_target_kind == released

not_measured: registered destination points vs placed-fruit cluster distance (why destination_overlap is 0.0): registry points are not recorded in chunks
per-point lifted 3D attention by patch (spill of table-patch attention onto table fruits): not recomputed
which non-target fruit U chose in held (cluster centroids not recorded in T54 rows)
attention of the executed action sample (serving attention is a separate model copy, noise seed 0, denoise step 0)

deviations: S class: in addition to the task definition (nearest GT object at the same frame), a second variant uses GT positions at manipulated.last_seen_frame (S_class_at_geometry_frame). Both are reported in every table and figure; the task-definition variant is labelled 'same frame'. Held-phase same-frame nearest distance median vs geometry-frame median are in numbers.S_nearest_distance.

Alignment: the task text says T54 t_step = frame*8 = T53 server t_step. The server chunk t_step is the request sequence (frame + 1); alignment used the T53 pairing chain (planning row t_step = 8*frame, planning seq = server t_step) plus chunk_index offset, manipulated.frame and exec_feedback.t_step_start checks. 0 / 1200 rows excluded.

Window end frame is included for both conditions (first placed frame and first HSR-home frame). The window rule's home cut is applied to failure episodes as well (ep1840 / ep1848 / ep1849 / ep1853 / ep1822 cut at first home; ep1843 / ep1851 have neither and run to frame 74). An exploratory no-cut version is reported separately.
placed phase (1 frame per success episode, the window end frame) is reported in tables; figure 2 shows pre / held / post only.
Scene frame choice rule (pre = lower-median pre frame of the window, held = first and last held frame with U != target) was set by the verifier before rendering; the task fixed only the episode rule.
esdf_free_distance is not recorded in attached chunks (held scene frames 17 / 30: target-free layers 0, exclusion source attached); those panels say so.

W2: '0.2 rad 안' implemented as distance <= 0.2 rad. The search starts at the first placed frame (inclusive); no episode is within 0.2 rad at its first placed frame (window_per_episode.ready_dist_at_first_placed_rad).

W2: frame q is the recorded qpos at the frame (state before the chunk executes); q_ready is measured_qpos[0] (state after control step 0) per the SUBTASK-e definition, so frame 0 distance is 0.0004-0.0032 rad, not 0.
W2 adds placed frames only (144); post frames are the same as in W1 (14 frames, 2 episodes: 1 success with 1 frame, 1 failure with 13 frames). Measures for post are reported but unchanged.
W2 table figure was rendered twice: the first rendering (overlapping panels) was removed by the verifier before t59_w2_table.py wrote the final t59-table-W2.png (same name, not a W1 file).
